name: Naughty Ventures Corp
summary: Naughty Ventures Corp. acquires and explores for mineral properties in Canada. The company explores for copper, zinc, silver deposits, and natural hydrogen and helium gas. It has an option to acquire 100% interests in the York Harbour Copper-Zinc project comprising 5 licenses and 156 claims covering an area of approximately 4,725-hectare located in west of Corner Brook, Newfoundland Canada and the Little Gull H2 Project consists of 286 mining cells approximately 4,576 hectares located in east-northeast of Thunder Bay, Ontario. The company was formerly known as York Harbour Metals Inc. and changed its name to Naughty Ventures Corp. in October 2025. Naughty Ventures Corp. is based in Port Moody, Canada.
